resource_note: Eight settings per pilot arm: 24 runs, eight times the one-setting pilot run count. Profile and cost all candidates, evaluation and retained adapters before selecting this panel. No training or purchase is launched by export.

selection.confirmation: Never use confirmation outcomes for selection
selection.evaluation: Final-step native-format accuracy on the same 120 development stories
selection.failures: Retain every failed run; no automatic omission, favorable replacement or expanded search
selection.freeze: Freeze the costed panel before pilot learning and selected family settings before confirmation
selection.rl: Maximize the mean over reasoning_rl and answer_rl at each shared setting
selection.sft: Maximize label_sft accuracy; reuse the selected setting for both SFT arms

source_caution: Zhong reports these rates but does not specify LoRA versus full fine-tuning. They are reference candidates, not established LoRA optima. The approximate 10x LoRA multiplier is empirical motivation for breadth, not a guaranteed conversion.
